description: Contrôles de propreté en gare is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Ce jeu de données informe sur le niveau de propreté des gares. La propreté des gares est un enjeu fort pour SNCF. En vue de satisfaire les clients, SNCF réalise, conjointement avec le prestataire, des contrôles de conformité de la prestation de nettoyage, dont la fréquence varie en fonction de l’importance de la gare. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Gares, Propreté. Its keywords are Propreté, Gares, Services en gare. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
